candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order (/v1/orders) fails with 502; the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Gateway-side evidence only; order service logs/metrics not observed, so the specific order-side fault (config, pool, latency) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s coincide with gateway client calls to order returning 502 in ~50-190ms, while /readyz stays 200 and gateway latency is low. Fault localizes to the order dependency; order-side evidence is needed to name the precise cause.
missing_evidence: Order service logs for /v1/orders showing the originating error and status
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency operations) for the same window
Order dependency health (postgresql, payment, inventory) to identify the failing sub-dependency
